label: PF Backlog 497
title: Backlog context gate enforces presence, not authorship: reject '(derived)' placeholders + author the remaining open items
body:
## Problem / why
The BI-PF-0448 context gate only enforces NON-EMPTY fields and a weak source tag; the BI-PF-0454 auto-draft fills '(derived)' placeholders and a >=40-char body yields source='extracted', so stubs PASS. Observed: 33/34 open items carried '(derived)' placeholders while the gate reported OK.

## Goal & value
Make the gate enforce authored plain-language context; no open item is a stub.

delivery.note: Hardened backlog_context_check to reject '(derived)' auto-draft placeholders + authored the open items from their bodies/links; merge --no-ff (no PR)
